SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 2.1.2 Self awareness, part of MYSELF Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experienc in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it good to have a sign name? 2. What do you like doing at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 2.1.2 Self awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Respect: Patience as the learner waits patiently to tell name, gender and what is liked most.

● Responsibility: Self drive as the learner identifies work done at home by boys and girls.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
.

● Citizenship as the learner becomes aware of right to a name and appreciation of gender roles.

● Self-awareness as a life skill as the learner correctly identifies self-using name, gender and ability.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Self-awareness is a necessary life skill across learning areas for it affects the performance of a learner due to the awareness of what

a learner can do and what is not capable of doing.
